description: Change a client workspace: its name, site, default destinations, and its monthly report (report_monthly emails report_to on the 1st; addresses confirm once).

api_key.description: Doorman API key (dm_live_...). Only needed if the MCP connection has no Authorization header.

email_to.description: Default comma-separated emails for the client's forms

report_badge.description: Show 'Protected by Doorman' on the report (turning it off needs Business)

report_monthly.description: Email the client last month's report on the 1st

report_to.description: The client's comma-separated addresses for the report

webhook_url.description: Default HTTPS webhook URL (signed with each form's secret)

name: doorman_update_workspace
